joints.name: joint_1
joints.limit_source: urdf position/velocity; acceleration: default: ABB publishes no per-joint acceleration limits; none in the URDF, and the pinned moveit/abb_irb1200_5_90_moveit_config/config/joint_limits.yaml sets has_acceleration_limits: false (max_acceleration: 0). 5.0 rad/s^2 is a conservative value (the same default UR ships for MoveIt), well below the real arm's capability, so trajectories are slow but always feasible
